title: Agricultural digestate nutrient and water recovery across membrane configurations
data_license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in the published article
evidence_type: peer-reviewed laboratory-scale primary experimental study; measured feed/stream concentrations and mass-based recovery means with SD
feedstock_scope: Agricultural digestate from a full-scale mesophilic anaerobic digester treating cow manure and lignocellulosic energy-crop residues; not grass-only and not GreenHub digestate
reference_year: Published 2025; digestate source plant sampled for laboratory filtration tests (sampling year not stated in the extracted article text)
source_locations: Table 1, raw agricultural digestate characterization, PDF p.2
Table 2, nutrient and water recovery, PDF p.4
Table 3, Line 1 stream characterization, PDF p.4-5
Table 4, Line 2 stream characterization, PDF p.5
Table 5, Line 3 stream characterization, PDF p.5
retrieval_and_transcription: Values transcribed from the publisher-hosted open-access article PDF retrieved via the University of Verona institutional repository. Table values and reported units/bases were retained. 'n.d.' is represented by a blank numeric cell and a status field; it is not zero. Recovery means and standard deviations are copied from Table 2, not recomputed.

process_conditions.preliminary_solid_liquid_separation: 2 mm, 500 µm, or 100 µm screens were tested; the reported filtration configurations included preliminary separation and centrifugation
process_conditions.line_1: MF (0.45 µm) + UF (300 kDa) + RO; MF and UF at 2 bar, RO at 30 bar
process_conditions.line_2: UF (300 kDa) + RO; UF at 2 bar, RO at 30 bar
process_conditions.line_3: NF (NF270) + RO; NF at 4.5 bar, RO at 30 bar
process_conditions.scale_up_design_basis: Authors report a designed demonstrative system for approximately 20 tonnes/day of agricultural digestate; this is not a built/validated plant performance result

units_and_basis.potassium_as_K2O_g_per_kg: g K2O/kg stream as reported; not elemental K
units_and_basis.recovery_pct: mass-based percent of initial nutrient or digestate feed mass, as defined in source Equations 1-3; total recovery includes recovered concentrate streams while RO-retentate recovery is a specific product-stream fraction
units_and_basis.uncertainty: Table 2 reports mean ± SD; replicate count is not specified in the extracted table text

applicability: Reference-only comparator for Phase 7 nutrient/water separation and stream-composition context. It is a manure/energy-crop digestate tested at laboratory scale. It does not validate GreenHub's grass digestate composition, membrane performance, product quality, economics, contaminant safety, or recoverable water reuse.
limitations: No direct roadside-grass or GreenHub digestate validation.
Concentrations alone are not component mass flows; only the source-reported Table 2 recoveries are mass-based recovery metrics.
The authors report initial laboratory filtration tests and note that extended cyclic/fouling testing remains future work.
The ~20 t/day plant is a design/scale-up basis and not observed commercial operation.
No GreenHub chemical demand, membrane electricity, lifecycle inventory, fertilizer regulatory qualification, or sales grade can be inferred from this dataset.
K is reported as K2O in Tables 2-5; it must not be relabeled as elemental potassium.
integration_status: reference_only; not connected to runtime parameters, defaults, equations, UI inputs, TEA, LCA, or Pareto scenarios
quality_interpretation: B denotes directly reported peer-reviewed literature evidence. Transferability is separately limited and does not imply GreenHub validation.
checksum_scope: SHA-256 values above cover the three CSV files; the FAIR catalog separately records checksums for every indexed asset.
